import os, pathlib, textwrap
program_dir=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Copy the non-background tile into every tile separated by solid lines."""
    from collections import Counter
    g=[list(row) for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Solid non-background rows and columns are tile dividers.
    div_rows=[r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg]
    div_cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    row_bounds=[-1]+div_rows+[h]
    col_bounds=[-1]+div_cols+[w]
    row_tiles=[(row_bounds[i]+1,row_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1)]
    col_tiles=[(col_bounds[i]+1,col_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]
    panels=[]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(row_tiles):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(col_tiles):
            cells=[g[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
            score=sum(v!=bg for v in cells)
            panels.append((score,ri,ci,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,_,_,sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=max(panels)
    tile=[row[sc0:sc1] for row in g[sr0:sr1]]
    for _,ri,ci,r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels:
        if (r0,r1,c0,c1)==(sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1):
            continue
        for rr,r in enumerate(range(r0,r1)):
            for cc,c in enumerate(range(c0,c1)):
                g[r][c]=tile[rr][cc]
    return g
'''
path=program_dir/'task-e8190e16.py'
path.write_text(source)
